documents.question: What does Axis & Sage do?
documents.answer: We get the people your business depends on to act: investors, partners, teams and customers. We find what's stopping them in the terms or the moment, and fix it in the strategy, the product or the brand.

documents.question: Is Conversion Design the same as conversion rate optimisation?
documents.answer: Conversion rate optimisation improves pages. We start earlier, with the structure, incentives and deal terms that decide whether people want to act. Then we design the product and the message that decide whether they can.

documents.question: Who do you work with?
documents.answer: Owners, CEOs and investors of groups and growing businesses; founders raising capital; and institutions running programmes. We work across Africa and the GCC.

documents.question: How does an engagement start?
documents.answer: With the Scorecard or a 30-minute call, then a fixed-fee Conversion Diagnostic. You know the price before we start.

documents.question: Do you raise capital or place investments?
documents.answer: No. We prepare businesses, materials and commercial structures for investor conversations. Clients and their licensed advisers manage solicitation, placement and regulated activity.

documents.question: Who does the work?
documents.answer: The founders lead every engagement. Specialists we've worked with join when the fix needs them, and they're named in the proposal.

documents.question: Where are you based?
documents.answer: We're registered in Masdar City Free Zone, Abu Dhabi, and the founders are in Dubai and Lagos. We work across Africa and the GCC, and in person when it helps.

documents.question: How quickly do you reply?
documents.answer: Within one working day, with a clear next step.

Notes, forms and calls.

When you send a note, use the "Who needs to act?" form or book a call, we collect your name, work email, company, role, the sentence you write, when it needs to happen, how you heard about us, and anything else you choose to tell us.
Tools.
When you finish a tool, we keep your answers and your result without your name or email, so we can see which tools help people. If you ask us to email you the result, we keep it with your email.
Newsletter.
When you subscribe to Terms & Moments, we keep your email address and your confirmation.
Bookings.
When you book a call, Cal.com passes us the details you give it.
How you found us.
We note the campaign link, the referring site and the first page you landed on. Your browser keeps this for 90 days and sends it to us only if you submit a form.
Technical data.
We count page views with Vercel Web Analytics, which doesn't use cookies. To stop our forms being abused, we use a scrambled (hashed) version of your IP address and keep it for a few hours at most.
We don't ask for sensitive personal data. Please don't send it to us.

sections.label: THE GAP
sections.title: Growth stalls in the gap between what a business decides, what it builds and what it says.
sections.intro: A board approves a new structure and managers keep deciding the old way. A product launches and customers stop at the payment screen. A raise opens and investors take the meeting, then go quiet. The decision was sound. The action never happened.

sections.label: CONVERSION DESIGN
sections.title: A conversion is the action your business needs from someone. It isn't always a sale.
sections.intro: Conversion Design starts with that action and works backwards. People act when two things are true: the terms are right and the moment is clear. Terms are what's on offer and who decides: the price, the equity, the incentive, the authority. Moments are where the decision happens: the pitch, the screen, the conversation, the form. We design both.

methodSteps.title: Name the action.
methodSteps.body: We need [who] to [do what] by [when]. One sentence, agreed before any work starts.

methodSteps.title: Find what's in the way.
methodSteps.body: The terms, the moment, or both. We talk to the people who need to act and walk the path they take.

methodSteps.title: Fix it.
methodSteps.body: In the strategy, the product or the brand. We build what's needed with your team.

methodSteps.title: Measure what moved.
methodSteps.body: The baseline goes on the first page of our report. The new number goes on the last.

methodStepsExpanded.title: Name the action.
methodStepsExpanded.body: One sentence, agreed with the people who own the outcome: we need [who] to [do what] by [when]. We agree how we'll measure it before work starts.

methodStepsExpanded.title: Find what's in the way.
methodStepsExpanded.body: We interview the people who need to act and the people who own the path to it. We walk the path ourselves. We read the numbers. Every blocker is tagged: terms, moment, or both.

methodStepsExpanded.title: Fix it.
methodStepsExpanded.body: Strategy & Investment fixes terms. Product & Technology fixes moments. Brand & Market fixes the promise and the message, which sit across both. We build with your team, and a principal stays until it runs.

methodStepsExpanded.title: Measure what moved.
methodStepsExpanded.body: Baseline on page one, new number on the last page. The number becomes the next decision.

question.title: Is this conversion rate optimisation?
question.body: Conversion rate optimisation improves pages. It works on the moment. We start earlier, with the terms: the structure, the incentives and the deal that decide whether people want to act. Then we design the moment.
